name: nullrpc-inline-setup
cpu:
ip link set cpu40g1 down
cpu configure 0c:53:31:03:01:c8 192.168.129.200/18
dmesg -n 4
ip neigh replace 192.168.128.225 lladdr 0c:53:31:03:00:e1 nud permanent dev lauberhorn0
mountpoint -q /sys/kernel/tracing || mount -t tracefs tracefs /sys/kernel/tracing
export LAUBERHORN_TRACE_CAPACITY=16384
cpu serve add 1 /scratch/pengxu/nullrpc-inline/server
export LH_BENCH_FLUSH_SPIN_US=100
mkdir /scratch/pengxu/nullrpc-inline/flush
nohup /nix/store/lauberhorn/apps/microbenchmarks/bin/microbenchmarks mul 4 > /scratch/pengxu/nullrpc-inline/flush/server.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
echo $! > /scratch/pengxu/nullrpc-inline/flush/server.pid
sleep 2
kill -0 "$(cat /scratch/pengxu/nullrpc-inline/flush/server.pid)"
cat /sys/module/lauberhorn/parameters/rx_hold_cycles > /scratch/pengxu/nullrpc-inline/rx-hold-cycles
cat /nix/store/lauberhorn/manifest.json > /scratch/pengxu/nullrpc-inline/deploy-manifest.json
